provenBug: Pinned audio producer interpreted socket.write(false) as failed delivery, immediately reported backpressure and destroyed an already accepted frame's socket.

runtime.source: Existing Node for Max executable named by actual b272 process receipt; executed only as a standalone bounded loopback test, never launched Live or Max.

correctedProducer.queuedPlusSocketBufferedWireByteLimit: 2 * negotiated maxFrameBytes, at most 262144 for native v2
correctedProducer.pendingRequestQuota: Existing default 64, unchanged; queued requests count toward it.
correctedProducer.queueScope: Current socket only; no offline audio replay or reconnect replay.
correctedProducer.cleanup: Write callback error, socket error/close, byte/pending quota or drain timeout remains fatal; stop cancels the wait and drops queued frames. Timer/listeners/pending queue are cleaned; stale callbacks cannot affect a replacement socket.
correctedProducer.wireAndAuthority: No payload, sequence, authentication, epoch, ACK or outer job/watchdog deadline contract changes. Drain is not a protocol ACK.

serverTrace.existingDrainHandling: Ingress already waits for drain with close/error handling and a 1000 ms timeout.
